column1: # RSpace accepted-match Bag publication: redundant two-root predecessor versus one BagDelta-owned COW root.
# Host: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 5975WX, 32 physical cores, SMT disabled; governor performance; pinned to CPUs 0-7, one shared-L3 CCD. Immediate preflight samples were 59% and 64% aggregate idle.

# Command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryHigh=6G -p MemoryMax=8G -p MemorySwapMax=0 taskset -c 0-7 /usr/bin/time -v cargo bench -p rspace_plus_plus --bench bag -- bag_atomic_delta_remove_shared_prefix --sample-size 82 --warm-up-time 2 --measurement-time 5 --noplot
# Criterion: one preregistered run, 82 regression samples per arm and cardinality, 2 s warm-up, 5 s requested measurement time. Runtime 53.53 s; process peak 570,124 KiB RSS; zero swap.

# Primary decision (pgmcp experiment/hypothesis 218): ACCEPTED. Singleton median improvement 5.671%; Welch t=-100.3226768864, p=1.1743230270934331e-138, Cohen's d=-15.6677698521, mean-difference 95% CI [-14.2211175289,-13.6717099880] ns. Both arms departed from normality, but Cliff's delta=-1 and the Mann-Whitney robustness p rounded to zero.

# Samples are Criterion's per-iteration regression observations (sample elapsed nanoseconds divided by iteration count). Pgmcp sealed 410 samples per arm, including all five cardinalities: control sha256:c16fb44c58e0c0a1d43335df20b4f34d5716c89a160860dc3d819769356a03f7; treatment sha256:26bc94b0ced2baa0cbacbb638b2e718c0b0601066f7b26ee7ccfaf876dd475b6.
